disposition_reason: EFSA EU-FORA fellowship report; the chocolate part reports Cd median and P95 (ICP-MS) for milk and bitter chocolate bars bought in Warsaw supermarkets plus an exposure estimate. Soft-drink BPA part is out of scope and ignored.
disposition_locator: Section 2.2.2, "Cadmium occurrence in chocolate bars" and Table 4

study.design: market survey with exposure assessment (training report)
study.material_scope: retail milk chocolate and bitter (dark/plain) chocolate bars
study.growing_origin_vs_market: Purchase market: supermarkets in Warsaw, Poland. Cocoa growing origin not reported.
study.sampling_unit: retail chocolate bars from different brands and cocoa percentages (number not reported)
study.method: ICP-MS (Thermo iCAP RQ, KED He mode), in-house method based on EN 15763:2009 after microwave mineralisation per EN 13805:2014 (0.250 g, HNO3 + H2O2, Y internal standard); external calibration; five readings per sample
study.qa: Two procedural blanks per run; method stated to fulfil Regulation (EC) 333/2007 performance criteria. No recovery or CRM values reported.

findings.censoring: No left-censored data reported (all results above LOQ 0.001 ug/g = 1 ug/kg)
findings.notes: Number of chocolate bars analysed is not reported. Purchased in Warsaw supermarkets; different brands and cocoa percentages. No left-censored data (all above LOQ 0.001 ug/g).

exposure_notes: Weekly Cd exposure = P95 occurrence x mean consumption (IZZ-FAO 2000 survey via EFSA Comprehensive Database) x 7. Children 3-9 y: milk 0.037, bitter 0.063; adolescents 10-17 y: milk 0.014, bitter 0.031; adults 18-64 y: milk 0.004, bitter 0.010 ug/kg bw/week; all below EFSA TWI 2.5 ug/kg bw (Table 5).
contradictions_with_stored_summary: Stored summary says "All samples below applicable EU maximum levels"; the primary only states that the occurrence of each chocolate group (median/P95) was below the ML, with no per-sample results reported.
Stored frontmatter sample_population gives "2022-2023" as the purchase period; the primary gives only the fellowship cycle (2022-2023) and a 3-month stay in Warsaw, not a sample collection date.
Stored summary maps milk chocolate to the 0.30 ug/g ML; milk chocolate with <30% cocoa solids has a 0.10 ug/g ML and the report does not give cocoa percentages per sample.
unresolved: Number of chocolate bars analysed is not reported (n unknown for both groups).
Paper says bitter chocolate was considered separately as <50% and >=50% cocoa solids for ML comparison, but no subgroup values are reported.
Sample collection dates not reported; only the 2022-2023 fellowship cycle is given.
Primary artifact is a Marker-converted markdown of the EFSA Journal PDF; no PDF was available in the access map. Table values read from the markdown.
